comparison.objective: Mix flour and liquid into dough while stabilizing a loose bowl; candidate separates ceramic media from washers using a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: One-hand bowl stabilization plus spoon-driven mixing of particulate/liquid material versus two-hand screen load sharing, lifting, tilting/agitation, and selective passage.
comparison.success_condition: Fraction of flour mixed, with bowl-tip and spill failures versus fraction of media recovered, complete washer retention, supported screen, release, and dwell.
comparison.reason: Both manipulate many-body contents and penalize spills, but homogenization in a bowl is the opposite physical outcome from geometry-selective separation. Missing rubric details: none material.
